keyPolicy.format: Namespaced, immutable string keys generated by the canonical scenario or assigned once by the operational system.
keyPolicy.sourceKeys: Retain sourceSystem, sourceTenant, sourceEntity, and sourceKey as a separate unique cross-reference. Never use email, display name, or a source-local numeric ID as a shared key.

commonFields.timestamps: UTC RFC 3339 timestamps. Keep event/effective time, source update time, ingestion time, publication time, and replay playback time distinct.
commonFields.unknownValues: Represent unavailable values as null with a reason/status; never coerce unavailable to zero.

financialPolicy.amountRepresentation: Integer minor units plus ISO 4217 currency; never binary floating point.
financialPolicy.tax: Every priced line states taxTreatment as exclusive, inclusive, or not_applicable and records tax separately when known.
financialPolicy.currencyConversion: No implicit conversion or cross-currency aggregation. An approved rate and rate timestamp are required for any future conversion.
financialPolicy.payment: PaymentSimulation is a persisted, explicitly simulated outcome. It is not a gateway transaction, bank charge, settlement, or revenue.
financialPolicy.credit: ScenarioCredit is not a bank refund. Full credit is assumed to revoke unconsumed entitlements; partial credit leaves entitlements unchanged. Consumed access is not reversed.
financialPolicy.revenue: Report commercial order value, simulated payment outcomes, posted customer invoices, credit documents, sponsorship contracted/invoiced/fulfilled values, and allocated costs separately.

entities.name: Event
entities.grain: One promoter event edition at one circuit and date range.
entities.unit: UTC event start/end instants; no monetary amount.
entities.planA: Oracle event/circuit identifiers cross-referenced to EventKey.
entities.planB: Deterministic synthetic event fixture; not an actual event.

entities.name: RaceSession
entities.owner: Authorized sports adapter; synthetic fixture owner for this package.
entities.grain: One practice, qualifying, or race session mapped to one EventKey.
entities.unit: UTC session instants and source-defined timing units.
entities.pii: public-person data only when licensed; synthetic in fixtures
entities.planA: Authorized sports-source session key mapped to SessionKey; coverage and rights must be verified.
entities.planB: Clearly labeled synthetic replay fixture; never represented as sourced telemetry.

entities.name: Driver
entities.grain: One participant identity within a source season/session mapping.
entities.unit: Source-defined position and timing units; no currency.
entities.planA: Authorized provider participant key cross-referenced to DriverKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic participant keys and names only.

entities.name: CircuitZone
entities.grain: One named sellable or operational zone within a circuit.
entities.unit: Capacity in integer places; no currency.
entities.planA: Oracle circuit-zone key cross-referenced to ZoneKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic zone master fixture.

entities.name: Product
entities.grain: One sellable product/SKU version, distinct from physical attendance.
entities.unit: Integer sellable quantity; prices live in Price.
entities.planA: Oracle SKU cross-referenced to ProductKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic catalog fixture; no claim of Oracle connectivity.

entities.name: BundleComponent
entities.grain: One component-product and quantity within one bundle version.
entities.unit: Integer component quantity.
entities.planA: Oracle bundle/BOM component cross-referenced to BundleComponentKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic bundle composition fixture.

entities.name: Price
entities.grain: One product, price list, currency, and effective interval.
entities.unit: Integer minor units and ISO 4217 currency.
entities.planA: Oracle rate/price-list key cross-referenced to PriceKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic price fixture with explicit currency and tax treatment.

entities.name: Party
entities.owner: Salesforce party cross-reference; Entra assignment is separate.
entities.grain: One person or organization represented in the business domain.
entities.unit: No currency; amounts belong to commercial or financial facts.
entities.pii: personal or business-contact data; minimized and access-controlled
entities.planA: Salesforce Account/Contact source key mapped without email joins.
entities.planB: Synthetic PartyKey fixtures; no real people or customer records.

entities.name: SponsorAccount
entities.grain: One sponsor organization account.
entities.unit: No currency; agreement values are in SponsorshipAgreement.
entities.planA: Salesforce Account key mapped to PartyKey and SponsorAccountKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic sponsor organization/account fixture.

entities.name: Campaign
entities.grain: One campaign definition.
entities.unit: No currency; campaign budget is not campaign revenue.
entities.pii: none; linked audience facts may be personal
entities.planA: Salesforce Campaign key mapped to CampaignKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic campaign fixture.

entities.name: Consent
entities.grain: One party, purpose, channel, and consent decision/version.
entities.unit: No currency.
entities.planA: Salesforce consent record key; preserve purpose and channel.
entities.planB: Synthetic consent fixture; never infer consent from a purchase.

entities.name: CampaignTouch
entities.grain: One recorded interaction for one party and campaign.
entities.unit: Integer count of one touch; no attribution revenue.
entities.pii: personal when linked to a person; restricted
entities.planA: Salesforce campaign-member/activity key mapped to CampaignTouchKey.
entities.planB: Synthetic touch fixture; no inferred conversion or ROI.

entities.name: CommercialOrder
entities.grain: One accepted commercial purchase command by one PartyKey for one event.
entities.unit: Integer minor-unit totals per ISO currency.
entities.pii: customer-linked; restricted to authorized roles and owner
entities.planA: Operational order remains distinct and links to, but is not duplicated by, SAP order.
entities.planB: Same operational contract with synthetic scenario inputs.

entities.name: CommercialOrderLine
entities.grain: One product/price/quantity line within one CommercialOrder.
entities.unit: Integer quantity, unit price, tax, and line totals in one currency.
entities.planA: Operational order line; cross-reference related ERP document line.
entities.planB: Synthetic order line using the same currency and tax rules.

entities.name: PaymentSimulation
entities.grain: One simulated payment attempt for one order and idempotency key.
entities.unit: Integer minor units and ISO currency equal to order amount.
entities.pii: restricted financial metadata; no card or bank data
entities.planA: Simulation only; it never calls a payment gateway or SAP settlement.
entities.planB: Simulation only; it never calls a payment gateway or SAP settlement.

entities.name: Reservation
entities.grain: One temporary or committed capacity allocation for a party/product/event.
entities.unit: Integer capacity quantity.
entities.planA: Oracle owns base capacity; operational reservation owns allocated quantity.
entities.planB: Same capacity rule against deterministic synthetic catalog input.

entities.name: Entitlement
entities.grain: One party's right to one product/content scope for one event/session.
entities.unit: Validity interval and integer permitted-use count where applicable.
entities.pii: customer-linked; fan can read only own entitlement
entities.planA: Operational state only; never granted by an analytical Gold refresh.
entities.planB: Same operational state using synthetic order/session keys.

entities.name: CRMCase
entities.owner: Salesforce case; operational support request keeps a separate link/state.
entities.grain: One support request concerning one party and optionally an order, entitlement, or event.
entities.unit: No currency; any credit is a separate ScenarioCredit.
entities.planA: Salesforce Case key linked to the app support request.
entities.planB: Synthetic case fixture; no real customer complaint.

entities.name: Incident
entities.grain: One operational issue/event affecting a defined scope.
entities.unit: UTC occurrence/resolution time and optional integer impact count.
entities.pii: none by default; restrict any linked case data
entities.planA: Promoter operational record with optional Salesforce Case link.
entities.planB: Synthetic incident fixture.

entities.name: ScenarioCredit
entities.grain: One explicitly approved scenario compensation against one order line.
entities.unit: Integer minor units and ISO currency; never exceeds eligible order balance.
entities.pii: restricted, linked to customer case and order
entities.planA: Link to a real supported SAP credit document only after authorized integration.
entities.planB: Synthetic scenario credit and credit memo; no money is returned.

entities.name: SponsorshipAgreement
entities.grain: One sponsor agreement for one sponsor account and event/term.
entities.unit: Contracted amount in integer minor units and one ISO currency.
entities.planA: Salesforce opportunity/agreement cross-reference; not inferred from exposure.
entities.planB: Synthetic agreement fixture; values are illustrative.

entities.name: SponsorshipCommitment
entities.grain: One measurable deliverable commitment within an agreement.
entities.unit: Integer fulfilled/contracted value with currency and evidence reference.
entities.pii: business-contact data if linked; otherwise none
entities.planA: Salesforce agreement deliverable/custom record mapped to commitment key.
entities.planB: Synthetic commitment fixture; no causal ROI is inferred.

entities.name: ERPDocument
entities.owner: SAP adapter or isolated Plan B scenario ledger
entities.grain: One source ERP order, invoice, credit document, or supplier document.
entities.unit: Integer document total per ISO currency; document type is mandatory.
entities.planA: SAP document from supported, authorized interface; failure remains pending/error.
entities.planB: Clearly synthetic scenario document; no connected SAP is claimed.

entities.name: ERPDocumentLine
entities.owner: SAP adapter or isolated Plan B scenario ledger
entities.grain: One source line within one ERPDocument.
entities.unit: Integer quantity, net, tax, and gross minor units with currency.
entities.planA: SAP source line key; preserve document and line relationships.
entities.planB: Synthetic document line with explicit tax treatment.

entities.name: DocumentLink
entities.grain: One typed relationship between a canonical business key and ERP document/line.
entities.unit: No currency.
entities.planA: Cross-reference actual SAP identifiers without pretending keys are identical.
entities.planB: Synthetic Plan B cross-reference within one dataset/publication.

entities.name: SupplierCost
entities.grain: One supplier cost item/document line and cost category.
entities.unit: Integer minor units and ISO currency.
entities.planA: SAP supplier invoice/line and cost-center source keys.
entities.planB: Synthetic supplier cost fixture; not a real payable.

entities.name: CostAllocation
entities.grain: One allocated share of one SupplierCost to one EventKey and optional sponsor/customer.
entities.unit: Integer minor units, same currency as source cost.
entities.planA: Map supported SAP cost-center/allocation facts; preserve source lineage.
entities.planB: Synthetic allocation fixture; no certified accounting claim.

entities.name: RaceEventEnvelope
entities.grain: One immutable normalized source event within a source session/publication.
entities.unit: Source-defined telemetry units; sequence is integer.
entities.pii: none by default; synthetic in fixtures
entities.planA: Authorized sports event key and original event time retained.
entities.planB: Synthetic fixture event with explicit synthetic provenance.

entities.name: ReplayRun
entities.grain: One isolated playback of one RaceSession and SourcePublication.
entities.unit: Playback speed factor and UTC playback clock.
entities.planA: Replay only from an authorized, rights-cleared publication.
entities.planB: Replay only from named synthetic fixture publication.

entities.name: SourcePublication
entities.grain: One immutable published version for one source, plan, dataset, and schema.
entities.unit: Record counts by entity; no implicit currency aggregation.
entities.planA: One identified publication of authorized real sources; never mix with Plan B.
entities.planB: One identified synthetic dataset/version with fixed seed and manifest.
